novel_features.name: Resort tradeoff frontier
novel_features.description: Show nondominated resort choices for explicitly selected statistics.
novel_features.rationale: Compare many saved source facts without hiding traveler preferences in a score.
novel_features.why_it_matters: When a traveler wants to expose numeric tradeoffs across a shortlist.

novel_features.name: Historical trip-window intersection
novel_features.description: Intersect a past trip window with recorded first/last season spans.
novel_features.rationale: Join resort identities with historical endpoints while preserving interruption uncertainty.
novel_features.why_it_matters: When exact historical date boundaries matter.

novel_features.name: Municipality option portfolios
novel_features.description: Compare source-defined towns by known resort options and statistical ranges.
novel_features.rationale: Group resort facts and historical evidence by exact municipality without assuming proximity.
novel_features.why_it_matters: When deciding which municipalities warrant further resort inspection.

novel_features.name: Historical evidence coverage
novel_features.description: Find listed resorts with missing or ambiguous historical endpoint evidence.
novel_features.rationale: Left-join the directory population to available season rows instead of mistaking omissions for closure.
novel_features.why_it_matters: When plans need explicit unknowns for a changed shortlist.

novel_features.name: Saved-fact changes
novel_features.description: See factual field changes between the latest two locally captured observations.
novel_features.rationale: Use normalized local snapshots to distinguish changed source facts from missing baselines.
novel_features.why_it_matters: After an explicit capture or sync, to inspect source edits without continuous monitoring.

narrative.headline: Compare Japan ski areas with terrain facts, dated reports and explicit historical-season evidence.
narrative.value_prop: Search and inspect public SnowJapan resort facts, compare a small shortlist, and read dated regional snow observations. Saved facts support tradeoff comparisons, municipality portfolios, historical span intersections and transparent evidence gaps.
narrative.auth_narrative: Public read-only HTML and provider-published charts; no account, API key or running browser is needed.

quickstart.comment: Find exact source identities for a ski shortlist.
Inspect terrain, installed lifts and source update status.
Inspect recorded endpoints from a completed winter.

troubleshoots.fix: Run snowjapan-pp-cli sync --resources resorts, then sync seasons with --resource-param seasons:season=2025-2026.

troubleshoots.symptom: Source fields or chart columns changed
troubleshoots.fix: Use the canonical source_url to inspect the provider page and update the parser; no empty success is returned on schema drift.

narrative.when_to_use: Use for Japan ski-area discovery and factual shortlist comparisons, dated regional snow observations, and recorded historical season evidence. Explicitly sync facts for offline tradeoffs, municipality portfolios and evidence-gap checks.
anti_triggers: Live open-lift status or safety guarantees
Predicting upcoming dates from past winters
